column1: # Skyrim SE runtime pin — tab-separated, one row per depot.
# Columns: depot  manifest  contains
# The game is pinned to runtime 1.6.1170. Every SKSE plugin is compiled against
# one runtime, so a Bethesda patch silently disables the entire mod set — see
# README.md, "The game version is pinned to 1.6.1170".
# These manifest IDs are the 1.6.1170 build of each depot. They are what
# `download_depot` in the Steam console asks Valve for, so the files come from
# Valve and no credentials are handed to anything.
# Provenance: recorded from the recovery run on 2026-08-20, logged in
# ~/.local/share/Steam/logs/console_log.previous.txt as
#   Depot download complete : ".../depot_489833" (manifest 1914580699073641964)
#   Depot download complete : ".../depot_489831" (manifest 8442952117333549665)
#   Depot download complete : ".../depot_489832" (manifest 8042843504692938467)
# and confirmed by the resulting SkyrimSE.exe reporting 1.6.1170.0.
# `files` and `mib` are what the Steam console reports when it starts each
# download ("Downloading depot 489831 (19 files, 4663 MB) ..."). The restore
# script checks the file count before copying, so a depot that was interrupted
# part-way cannot be laid over the install as though it were complete.
# Do NOT replace these with whatever the current build downloads. The acf's
# InstalledDepots records the *live* build's manifests, which is a different
# set and is what Steam re-applies when it updates.
